services.desc: At SKY Helicopters we offer one on one training for FAR Part 141 and FAR Part 61 for the following certifications. This lets a student advance at their own time and at their own pace. "Stop paying for one lesson at a time, apply for a loan today so you can get your training done faster!" SKY's Helicopter Simulator will help the student with technical proficiency and financial cost of flight training. This is accomplished by providing more time in the cockpit environment with a much lower cost per hour. The simulator is configurable for both of the Robinson Helicopters and other model

includes: Demo flights include 30 minutes flight time and 30 minutes 1-on-1 course work with instructor

blurb: Guests can take helicopter tours over Dallas and Fort Worth or pursue various helicopter pilot certifications including private, instrument, commercial, CFI, and ATP. Tours include sightseeing of landmarks and are subject to weight limits and weather conditions. Pilot training includes ground instruction, flight hours, and FAA testing requirements.
